pages.title: Alkahest Still
pages.text: A tall glass still with a reflux column, for the one distillation the alchemists never finished.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the still's temperature and the reflux ratio. Each stage boils off near its own temperature; more reflux makes it purer but slower. Purity must reach 95%. More than 150 K over the boiling point and it boils over.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 3 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Alkahest, Copper Ingot, Gold Ingot, Iron Ingot, Tincture of Balance, Tincture of Chirality, Tincture of Form.
